text:
maria.partnerships: Quick sync — we're shipping the first batch of SI Starter Kits next week (cloud credits + hw voucher + lab creds). Need confirmation on two things: 1) lab access flow (temp tokens vs SSO) 2) mentor schedule for hands-on day. ETA: ship Thurs.

kai.si_onboarding: Thanks Maria — for lab access I'd prefer short-lived tokens we can rotate. SSO adds support overhead for partners. Can we do token + email invite for cohort 1? :thinking_face:

tom.eng_ops: We can spin up token generation and an enrollment endpoint. I'll create a one-time script and an audit log. Plan: token TTL 7 days, single-use. Any objections?

ana.training: Putting hands-on day on calendar tentatively: Wed 10/14, 10:00-14:00 PT. We'll do paired breakout rooms. Need list of mentors and their timezones.

linda.sales: FYI — marketplace listing and joint announcement want the same kit image + a partner quote. If we delay mentor list, we risk missing the announcement date (10/21). Can mentors commit? :grimacing:
\
kai.si_onboarding: I'll double-check mentor commitments. Preliminary roster: @mike_si_lead (EMEA), @jess_si_eng (US), @tess_support (APAC). Mike said he can do EMEA evening slot.

maria.partnerships: Good. Tom — if tokens are single-use, how will partner SIs onboard multiple engineers? We need a self-serve path or a small portal.
\
tom.eng_ops: Suggestion: batch token creation per partner org. Command to create 10 tokens (example):

```
# generate 10 starter tokens for partner org 'acme-si'
rdwctl tokens create --org acme-si --count 10 --ttl 168h --single-use
```

We'll post tokens to the partner portal (secure link) and log issuance.

ana.training: For assessment, propose a short lab rubric: 1) deploy a model endpoint, 2) configure autoscaling policy, 3) run a perf test <200ms p50 for demo prompt. Pass/fail + notes. That keeps grading quick.

linda.sales: Perfect — the rubric will be used in partner badging. One question: are hardware vouchers single redemption? Legal asked.

kai.si_onboarding: Vouchers are single redemption per partner company, redeemable via HW marketplace page. We also bundle an "expedited shipping" code for certified partners.

maria.partnerships: Action items — Tom to drop token script + portal link by EOD Tue; Kai to confirm mentor roster by EOD Wed; Ana to publish calendar invite + rubric doc; Linda to align announcement copy and date. I'll draft a short runbook for partners (shipping, voucher redemption, token usage).

deploy-bot: CI:starter-kit-runbook-md (main) — build passed in 1m 12s :white_check_mark:

tom.eng_ops: Uploaded script and a minimal portal stub: https://intranet.redwood/si-portal/starter-kits (internal). Script and instructions in the repo — sample usage shown above. I'll send prod publish request after security signoff.

ana.training: Shared rubric draft: https://docs.redwood/si/rubrics/starter-kit-v1 — please review in the next 24h.

maria.partnerships: Thanks team. If we hit these checkpoints, we can do soft-launch to the first 5 SIs on 10/14 and full announcement on 10/21. I'll follow up with a short checklist in this thread. :rocket:
